results.notes: 32 distinct WebSearch queries. All citing papers below were harvested from full-text search hits (arxiv.org/pdf|html and aclanthology.org PDFs are full-text indexed, so a quoted-phrase hit for 'SFR-RAG' on a paper's own PDF/HTML indicates the string appears in its body/references) or from explicit reference-list snippets. Coverage is therefore partial-but-verified: ~20 of ~31 Google Scholar citations. Could not open scholar.google.com or semanticscholar citation listings directly (egress blocked; WebSearch snippets only).

citing_papers.evidence: Its arXiv PDF, html v5, and AAAI proceedings PDF all returned as full-text hits for quoted "CodeUpdateArena" across four queries; search snippets include third-person citing descriptions of the target and report training on it.
context_snippets: CodeUpdateArena (Liu et al. 2025) is designed to evaluate the ability of LLMs to handle API updates. The dataset comprises 670 program synthesis tasks, covering updates to 54 functions across seven different Python packages.

For CodeUpdateArena, they take the approach of training LLMs using the updated API function—using docstrings or examples—and then test if without access to the update during inference, the LLM's reflects the synthetic changes.
